text: Claude is not one single model, but a family of models.
Like hiring help, you match the tier to the task.
Small, fast models like Haiku handle quick edits, sorting, and short summaries.
Balanced models like Sonnet manage everyday drafting and analysis.
Most capable models like Opus tackle hard, multi-step, high-stakes problems.
Furthermore, thinking models work through complex problems step by step before answering—like working it out on paper.
Claude is also multimodal, allowing you to share charts, PDFs, and whiteboard photos.
Always match the model to the job: start balanced, and remember that bigger is not always better.
